dict.string: RAIDORoster can add your roster duties to Calendar when you ask it to.
RAIDORoster uses your location for Flight Companion position and automatic flight detection.
RAIDORoster uses low-power background location near a rostered departure to arm Flight Companion automatically, then stops after the flight session.
RAIDORoster uses Motion & Fitness sensors for Flight Companion phase detection and flight-state diagnostics.
RAIDORoster uses Face ID to unlock your private Crew Documents vault.
Scan paper documents into your private crew document storage.
